text: Assumption: Thread safety is missing during simultaneous access — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Thread safety is missing during simultaneous access — is this correct?
norm: thread safety is missing during simultaneous access
assumption: Thread safety is missing during simultaneous access.
rationale: The payload is silent regarding synchronization, which is why, analogously to the C++ standard behavior [basic.string], a lack of thread safety shall be assumed for mutating methods without protection.

original.text: Annahme: Fehlende Thread-Sicherheit bei gleichzeitigem Zugriff — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Der Payload schweigt zur Synchronisation, weshalb analog zum C++-Standardverhalten [basic.string] bei mutierenden Methoden ohne Schutz von fehlender Thread-Sicherheit ausgegangen werden muss.
